entries.en: The engineer examined the aerosolizer after droplets began collecting around its outlet.
entries.zh: 出口周围开始积聚液滴后，工程师检查了烟雾器。

entries.en: The historical course in aerosolology included a discussion of inhalation equipment.
entries.zh: 那门历史上的气溶胶治疗学课程包含了对吸入设备的讨论。

entries.en: The lesson in aerostatics examined how a balloon could remain in equilibrium.
entries.zh: 那堂空气静力学课研究了气球如何保持平衡。

entries.en: Her aerothermodynamics project examined heating around a model travelling at high speed.
entries.zh: 她的气动热力学项目研究了高速运动模型周围的加热现象。

entries.en: The old report described aerothorax, with air visible around the affected lung.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告描述了气胸，患侧肺周围可见空气。

entries.en: The case history linked aerotitis to ear pain during the flight.
entries.zh: 那份病史将航空耳炎与飞行期间的耳痛联系起来。

entries.en: The physiology class compared aerotonometry readings for the two blood samples.
entries.zh: 生理学课上比较了两份血液样本的气体张力测量读数。

entries.en: The historical lecture discussed aerotympanal pressure changes alongside the anatomy of the middle ear.
entries.zh: 那堂历史医学讲座将鼓室内空气压力的变化与中耳解剖结构一并讨论。

entries.en: The museum displayed an aerourethroscope beside other early instruments for examining the urethra.
entries.zh: 博物馆将一件充气尿道镜与其他早期尿道检查器械陈列在一起。

entries.en: The old zoology text classified the air-breathing animal as an aerozoon.
entries.zh: 那本旧动物学书将这种呼吸空气的动物归为需气动物。

entries.meaningZh: 埃斯基涅斯〔古雅典政治家〕
entries.en: The students compared two translations of a speech attributed to Aeschines.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了一篇据称由埃斯基涅斯所作的演说的两种译本。

entries.en: The analyst compared the aescin sample with the reference material before writing her report.
entries.zh: 分析员在撰写报告前，将七叶素样品与参比材料作了比较。

entries.en: The art historian examined the Aesculapian symbols carved above the old doorway.
entries.zh: 那位艺术史学家研究了旧门口上方雕刻的医神艾斯库累普的象征图案。

entries.en: The laboratory notebook recorded a separate identification test for aesculin.
entries.zh: 实验室笔记记录了一项针对七叶树素的单独鉴定试验。

entries.en: The lecturer compared the Aesopian fable with a modern story about the same animals.
entries.zh: 讲课者将那则伊索寓言与一篇涉及相同动物的现代故事作了比较。

entries.en: The student labelled each aesthacyte in the enlarged diagram of the sensory tissue.
entries.zh: 学生在感觉组织的放大图中标出了每个感觉细胞。

entries.en: The technician checked the aethylparabenum sample number before sending the results to her colleague.
entries.zh: 技术员在将结果发给同事前，核对了对羟基苯甲酸乙酯的样品编号。

entries.en: The chemistry students compared two drawings of the aetiocholane skeleton.
entries.zh: 化学专业的学生比较了两张5β-雄烷骨架图。

entries.en: The old atlas placed Aetolia beside several other regions discussed in the history lesson.
entries.zh: 那本旧地图集将埃托利亚与历史课上讨论的其他几个地区列在一起。

entries.en: The museum catalogue grouped the Aetolian objects on a separate page.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录将埃托利亚的物品归在单独一页上。

entries.en: The technician checked the AEWS warning against the computer's event log before calling support.
entries.zh: 技术员在联系技术支持前，把高级预警系统的警报与计算机的事件日志作了核对。

entries.en: The historical pathology lecture contrasted an afetal specimen with one containing a fetus.
entries.zh: 那堂历史病理学课将一份无胎标本与一份含有胎儿的标本作了对比。

entries.en: The old paper examined affectomotor responses during moments of sudden emotional excitement.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论文研究了情绪突然激动时的感情运动性反应。

entries.en: The older brain sketch marked the affenspalte with a dotted line near the occipital region.
entries.zh: 那幅较早的脑部示意图用虚线在枕部附近标出了月状沟。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing showed the afferentia entering the organ from the left.
entries.zh: 那张解剖图显示输入管从左侧进入该器官。

entries.en: The researcher compared the affinin spectrum with the reference spectrum in the appendix.
entries.zh: 研究人员将假向日葵酰胺的光谱与附录中的参比光谱作了比较。

entries.en: The agreement required permission before the affixture of any sign to the wall.
entries.zh: 该协议要求，往墙上贴任何标牌前都必须取得许可。

entries.en: The diagram shows an afflux of water towards the centre of the drainage basin.
entries.zh: 该图显示了水向集水区中心汇流的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 只关注遥远问题而忽视本地争议的作风
entries.en: She criticised the newspaper's Afghanistanism when it ignored pollution on its own doorstep.
entries.zh: 当那家报纸无视身边的污染问题时，她批评了它只关注遥远问题的作风。

entries.meaningZh: 美国信息处理学会联合会
entries.en: The archivist found an old AFIPS brochure between two conference programmes.
entries.zh: 档案员在两份会议日程册之间找到了一本美国信息处理学会联合会的旧宣传册。

entries.en: The textile student compared the Afiume fibres with a finer grade of flax.
entries.zh: 纺织专业的学生将阿菲乌姆粗亚麻纤维与一种较细的亚麻作了比较。

entries.en: The veterinary case discussion distinguished aflatoxicosis from an infection with similar symptoms.
entries.zh: 那次兽医病例讨论区分了黄曲霉毒素中毒与一种症状相似的感染。

entries.en: The traveller marked Afognak on the map before comparing the proposed routes.
entries.zh: 那位旅行者先在地图上标出了阿福格纳克岛，然后比较拟议的路线。

entries.en: Afonso moved the wet chairs under the shelter before opening the gate.
entries.zh: 阿丰索先把湿椅子搬到遮蔽处，然后打开了门。

entries.en: The historian discussed the old anthology's Aframerican poems without adopting its dated terminology.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家讨论了旧选集中的美国黑人诗歌，但没有沿用书中过时的术语。

entries.en: In the final stanza, the poet imagines an Afric dawn beyond the sea.
entries.zh: 在最后一节中，诗人想象着海那边非洲的黎明。

entries.en: The essay questions how Africanness is defined across different artistic traditions.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了不同艺术传统如何界定非洲性。

entries.meaningZh: Afrin〔盐酸羟甲唑啉制剂商品名〕
entries.en: The pharmacist checked the unopened Afrin bottles against the delivery list.
entries.zh: 药剂师对照送货清单核查了未开封的Afrin制剂瓶。

entries.en: Her essay on Afro-Americanism compares the cultural themes of two fictional family histories.
entries.zh: 她那篇论述美国黑人文化的文章比较了两部虚构家族史的文化主题。

entries.en: The designer moved the Afroed mannequin closer to the studio window.
entries.zh: 设计师把那个戴着蓬松卷发假发的人体模特移到了更靠近工作室窗户的位置。

entries.meaningZh: 非洲未来主义〔从黑人文化视角想象未来的文化思潮〕
entries.en: Her essay explores Afrofuturism through paintings that imagine Black communities living among distant stars.
entries.zh: 她的文章通过描绘黑人社群生活在遥远星际的画作，探讨了非洲未来主义。

entries.meaningZh: 对非洲黑人文化的兴趣
entries.en: His Afroism prompted him to collect recordings of traditional music from several African regions.
entries.zh: 他对非洲黑人文化的兴趣促使他收集了来自非洲几个地区的传统音乐录音。

entries.en: The field notebook recorded an afrormosia beside the path and sketched its leaves.
entries.zh: 那本野外笔记记录了小路旁的一棵非洲红豆树，并画出了它的叶片。

entries.en: The curator placed Afrotropical specimens in a separate cabinet for comparison.
entries.zh: 馆员将非洲热带区的标本放在单独一个柜子里，以便比较。

entries.en: The old obstetric report recorded an examination of the after-birth after delivery.
entries.zh: 那份旧产科报告记录了分娩后对胞衣进行的检查。

entries.en: The discharge summary included a separate section on after-care following the operation.
entries.zh: 出院小结中有一个单独的部分，介绍手术后的照护。

entries.en: The engineer placed the after-cooler between the compressor and the storage vessel in the drawing.
entries.zh: 工程师在图中将后置冷却器放在压缩机与储存容器之间。

entries.en: The recording showed a small after-current after the main electrical stimulus had ended.
entries.zh: 记录显示，主要电刺激结束后仍有一股微弱的后电流。

entries.meaningZh: 煤矿爆炸后的有毒气体
entries.en: In the historical novel, after-damp made the damaged mine dangerous even after the explosion.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，爆炸过后产生的有毒气体仍使受损煤矿充满危险。

entries.en: She regarded the lingering tiredness as an after-effect of the long journey.
entries.zh: 她认为，久久不退的疲倦是那次长途旅行的后效应。

entries.en: A faint after-image of the bright square remained when he looked at the blank wall.
entries.zh: 当他看向空白墙面时，那个明亮方块的微弱后象仍然存在。

entries.en: The old psychology lecture described an after-impression that persisted after the sound stopped.
entries.zh: 那堂旧式心理学课描述了声音停止后仍持续存在的后感觉。

entries.en: The case notes described the after-pains separately from the pain during delivery.
entries.zh: 病例记录将产后痛与分娩过程中的疼痛分开描述。

entries.en: The observer described an after-perception of pressure after the weight had been lifted.
entries.zh: 观察者描述，在重物被抬起后，仍有压力的后知觉。

entries.en: The student marked the after-potential on the trace following the main nerve impulse.
entries.zh: 学生在记录曲线上标出了主要神经冲动之后的后电位。

entries.en: The participant reported an after-sensation of vibration after the device had stopped moving.
entries.zh: 装置停止运动后，那位参与者报告说仍有振动的后感觉。

entries.en: The process drawing showed an after-settler downstream of the first settling tank.
entries.zh: 工艺图显示，第一座沉降池下游设有一个二次澄清器。

entries.en: The slide notes distinguished the after-stain from the first dye used on the tissue.
entries.zh: 玻片记录区分了复染剂与最先用于该组织的染料。

entries.en: The tea had a pleasant aroma but left a slightly bitter after-taste.
entries.zh: 这种茶香气宜人，但留下了略苦的余味。

entries.en: The old experiment recorded after-vision even when the coloured target was no longer visible.
entries.zh: 那项旧实验记录到，即使已看不见彩色目标，仍存在后像知觉。

entries.en: The materials report examined changes in the rubber samples during after-vulcanization.
entries.zh: 那份材料报告研究了橡胶样品在后硫化过程中的变化。

entries.en: The student shaded the afterbrain in blue on the simplified anatomical diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在那张简化的解剖图上用蓝色涂出了后脑。

entries.en: The seed study compared germination before and after a period of afterripening.
entries.zh: 那项种子研究比较了一段后熟期前后的发芽情况。

entries.meaningZh: 阿夫顿间冰期的〔旧地质术语〕
entries.en: The old geological report compared the Aftonian deposits with the layer above them.
entries.zh: 那份旧地质报告将阿夫顿间冰期沉积物与其上方的地层作了比较。

entries.en: The older case report used afunction to describe the organ's complete lack of activity.
entries.zh: 那份较早的病例报告用机能缺失来描述该器官完全没有活动的状态。

entries.en: The museum displayed an afwillite specimen beside a drawing of its crystal structure.
entries.zh: 博物馆在柱硅钙石标本旁展示了一张晶体结构图。

entries.en: The traveller kept the bus ticket from Afyon inside her notebook.
entries.zh: 那位旅行者把从阿菲永出发的车票夹在了笔记本里。

entries.en: The analyst compared the afzelechin peak with the reference chromatogram supplied with the sample.
entries.zh: 分析员将阿夫儿茶精的峰与样品所附的参比色谱图作了比较。

entries.en: The student located Agade on the historical map before reading the accompanying notes.
entries.zh: 学生先在历史地图上找到了亚甲，然后阅读了附带的说明。

entries.en: The postcard from Agadir arrived after we had already returned from our holiday.
entries.zh: 来自阿加迪尔的明信片在我们度假归来后才寄到。

entries.en: The old recipe used agal-agal to set the dessert without any animal gelatin.
entries.zh: 那份旧食谱用琼脂使甜点凝固，没有使用任何动物明胶。

entries.en: The old laboratory record noted agalactosuria after finding no galactose in the urine sample.
entries.zh: 那份旧化验记录在尿液样本中未检出半乳糖后，记载了无半乳糖尿的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 与乳汁分泌减少或缺乏有关的〔医学词典用语〕
entries.en: The medical notes described an agalactous condition, with milk production much lower than expected.
entries.zh: 病历描述了一种乳汁分泌不足的状态，乳汁分泌量远低于预期。

entries.en: The mineralogy class compared the fibrous agalite specimen with a smoother piece of talc.
entries.zh: 矿物学课上比较了纤维状的纤滑石标本与一块较光滑的滑石。

entries.en: The lecture discussed agammaglobulinaemia in a case with very low antibody levels.
entries.zh: 讲座结合一个抗体水平很低的病例讨论了丙种球蛋白缺乏症。

entries.en: The old zoological catalogue placed the specimen under Agamofilaria rather than the neighbouring genus.
entries.zh: 那本旧动物学目录将该标本归在缺母丝虫属下，而不是相邻的那个属下。

entries.en: The diagram separated agamogony from the sexual phase of the organism's life cycle.
entries.zh: 该图将这个生物生活史中的无性生殖期与有性阶段分开表示。

entries.en: The observer sketched an agamont dividing while the other student recorded the sequence.
entries.zh: 观察者画下一个正在分裂的裂殖体，另一名学生则记录这一过程。

entries.meaningZh: 不完全无配生殖〔不经受精形成种子〕
entries.en: Her study of agamospermy compared seed formation in two groups of plants.
entries.zh: 她关于不完全无配生殖的研究比较了两组植物的种子形成情况。

entries.en: The student drew an agamospore beside the diagram showing reproduction without gamete fusion.
entries.zh: 学生在显示无配子融合生殖的图旁画了一个无性孢子。

entries.en: The old travel journal described an evening walk through Agana after the rain.
entries.zh: 那本旧游记描述了一次雨后傍晚穿行于阿加尼亚的散步。

entries.en: The historical classification chart listed Agarbacterium separately from the two neighbouring genera.
entries.zh: 那张历史分类表将琼脂杆菌属与相邻的两个属分开列出。

entries.en: The chemist compared the agarbiose sample with the reference sugar in the appendix.
entries.zh: 化学家将琼脂二糖样品与附录中的参比糖作了比较。

entries.en: The old botanical plate grouped the agaricaceous fungi on a separate page.
entries.zh: 那张旧植物图版将菌蕈科的真菌归在单独一页上。

entries.en: The curator found dried agaricus inside a sealed container from the old pharmacy.
entries.zh: 馆员在一只来自那家旧药房的密封容器里发现了干燥的落叶松蕈。

entries.en: The laboratory report listed the measured agaritine content separately for each mushroom sample.
entries.zh: 那份实验室报告分别列出了各个蘑菇样品中测得的伞菌氨酸含量。

entries.en: The researcher checked the agarobiose peak against a reference chromatogram before accepting the identification.
entries.zh: 研究人员在接受鉴定结果前，将琼脂二糖的峰与参比色谱图进行了核对。

entries.en: Her letter from Agartala described the books she had found in a small shop.
entries.zh: 她从阿加尔塔拉寄来的信描述了她在一家小店里找到的书。

entries.en: The historical plate showed an agaster with the absent stomach noted beneath the drawing.
entries.zh: 那张历史图版展示了一个无胃畸胎，并在图下注明胃缺失。

entries.en: The comparative anatomy lecture contrasted the agastric animal with one possessing a distinct stomach.
entries.zh: 那堂比较解剖学课将这种无胃动物与一种具有明显胃结构的动物作了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 胃神经兴奋缺乏〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical case notes discussed agastroneuria alongside other proposed explanations for the stomach's inactivity.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例记录讨论了胃神经兴奋缺乏，以及其他用来解释胃活动不足的假说。

entries.meaningZh: 阿加托克利斯〔利西马科斯之子〕
entries.en: The biography's family tree placed Agathocles, the son of Lysimachus, on a separate branch.
entries.zh: 那部传记的族谱将利西马科斯之子阿加托克利斯列在单独的分支上。

entries.en: The student compared two accounts of Agaw traditions without assuming every community was identical.
entries.zh: 学生比较了两份关于阿皋部族传统的记述，没有假定每个群体都一样。

entries.en: The old zoological chart placed Agchylostoma beside other hookworm genera discussed in the chapter.
entries.zh: 那张旧动物学分类表将钩口属与该章讨论的其他钩虫属并列。

entries.en: The model allowed an age-dependent response rather than assuming every age group behaved alike.
entries.zh: 该模型允许反应随年龄变化，而不是假定每个年龄组的表现都相同。

entries.en: A small vial of agedoite remained unopened beside the other amino-acid samples.
entries.zh: 一小瓶天冬酰胺放在其他氨基酸样品旁，仍未打开。

entries.en: The historical case conference discussed agenitalism in relation to the absence of gonadal secretions.
entries.zh: 那次历史病例讨论会结合生殖腺分泌物缺失的情况讨论了生殖腺机能缺失。

entries.en: She compared the agennetic animals with a group that had successfully reproduced.
entries.zh: 她将那些无生殖力的动物与一组已经成功繁殖的动物作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 无生殖器畸胎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old anatomical drawing depicted an agenosomus with the genital region enlarged in an inset.
entries.zh: 那张旧解剖图描绘了一个无生殖器畸胎，并在插图中放大展示了生殖器区域。

entries.en: The experiment compared ageotropic growth with growth that changed direction in response to gravity.
entries.zh: 该实验比较了不向地性的生长与响应重力而改变方向的生长。

entries.en: The flow diagram placed the ager between the mixing vessel and the next processing stage.
entries.zh: 流程图将熟化器置于混合容器与下一加工阶段之间。

entries.en: The case discussion distinguished ageusia from a reduced but still detectable sense of taste.
entries.zh: 病例讨论区分了味觉缺失与味觉减退但仍能感知味道的情况。

entries.en: The lecturer described an ageusic patient who could smell the soup but could not taste it.
entries.zh: 讲课者描述了一名能闻到汤的气味却尝不出味道的失味患者。

entries.en: The historical case note recorded ageustia despite the patient's ability to recognise familiar smells.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例记录记载了患者虽能辨认熟悉的气味，却存在味觉缺失。

entries.meaningZh: 阿加达；犹太教传统中的叙事和说教材料
entries.en: The seminar on Aggadah examined how a story illustrated the point under discussion.
entries.zh: 那场关于阿加达的研讨会探讨了一个故事如何阐明所讨论的要点。

entries.en: The old report identified an agglutinator in the serum but did not establish its structure.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告在血清中鉴定出了一种凝集素，但没有确定它的结构。

entries.en: The historical account described an agglutinoid that bound to cells without making them clump.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述描述了一种能与细胞结合、却不使细胞凝集的类凝集素。

entries.en: The old study compared agglutinophilic cells with cells that remained dispersed in the same preparation.
entries.zh: 那项旧研究比较了易凝集细胞与同一制备物中仍保持分散状态的细胞。

entries.en: The museum's agglutinoscope stood beside a drawing showing its magnifying lens.
entries.zh: 博物馆的凝集反应镜旁边放着一张展示其放大镜片的图。

entries.meaningZh: 与凝集素产生有关的〔旧医学词典义〕
entries.en: The old study compared the agglutogenic properties of the two bacterial preparations.
entries.zh: 那项旧研究比较了两种细菌制剂在凝集素产生方面的特性。

entries.en: The researchers compared aggrecan levels in the two cartilage samples without proposing a treatment.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两份软骨样本中的聚集蛋白聚糖水平，但未提出治疗方案。

entries.meaningZh: 攻击素〔旧医学假说中的物质〕
entries.en: The historical chapter discussed the proposed role of aggressin in bacterial virulence.
entries.zh: 那个历史章节讨论了关于攻击素在细菌毒力中作用的假说。

entries.en: The historical case note described agitographia, with letters omitted during unusually rapid writing.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例记录描述了急躁性错写，患者写字异常迅速，出现了漏字母的情况。

entries.en: The old lecture contrasted agitolalia with rapid speech that remained clearly articulated.
entries.zh: 那堂旧式讲座将急躁性错语与虽说得快却仍吐字清楚的言语作了对比。

entries.en: The historical report described agitophasia in speech that became indistinct as its pace increased.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告描述了急躁性错语，说话速度加快时，言语变得含糊不清。

entries.en: The anatomy class compared the aglandular region with the gland-rich tissue beside it.
entries.zh: 解剖学课上比较了无腺区域与其旁边富含腺体的组织。

entries.en: The historical colour-vision discussion examined aglaucopsia separately from a complete inability to perceive colours.
entries.zh: 那次历史上的色觉讨论将绿色盲与完全不能感知颜色的情况分开研究。

entries.en: The historical account linked aglaukopsia with difficulty recognising green, rather than reduced visual sharpness.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述将绿色盲与辨认绿色的困难联系起来，而非与视力清晰度下降相联系。

entries.en: The old clinical drawing showed an aglia near the edge of the cornea.
entries.zh: 那张旧临床图在角膜边缘附近画出了一处角膜斑。

entries.en: The old case report recorded aglobulia alongside a reduced red-cell count.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告记载了红细胞减少，同时记录了降低的红细胞计数。

entries.meaningZh: 红细胞减少〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical chapter discussed aglobuliosis through cases with unusually low red-cell counts.
entries.zh: 那个历史章节通过红细胞计数异常低的病例讨论了红细胞减少。

entries.meaningZh: 红细胞减少〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old account connected aglobulism with changes in the number of red corpuscles.
entries.zh: 那份旧记述将红细胞减少与红血球数量的变化联系起来。

entries.en: The comparative anatomy diagram showed an aglomerular kidney beside one containing glomeruli.
entries.zh: 那张比较解剖图将无肾小球的肾与含有肾小球的肾并列展示。

entries.meaningZh: 无舌亚目〔旧动物分类名〕
entries.en: The old amphibian classification placed Aglossa beside a group whose members possessed tongues.
entries.zh: 那套旧两栖动物分类将无舌亚目与一个成员具有舌头的类群并列。

entries.en: The lecture discussed congenital aglossia separately from difficulties moving an existing tongue.
entries.zh: 讲座将先天性无舌畸形与已有舌头却活动困难的情况分开讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 无舌锁口畸胎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old anatomical plate depicted an aglossostoma, with the mouth region shown in a separate detail.
entries.zh: 那张旧解剖图版描绘了一个无舌锁口畸胎，并用一幅单独的详图展示口部区域。

entries.en: The historical illustration depicted an aglossus and included a separate view of the oral cavity.
entries.zh: 那幅历史插图描绘了一个无舌畸胎，并附有口腔的单独视图。

entries.en: The chemical scheme showed the aglucon after the sugar portion had been removed.
entries.zh: 该化学示意图显示了去掉糖部分后剩下的苷元。

entries.en: The researcher compared the aglucone with the complete glycoside in the next diagram.
entries.zh: 研究人员将苷元与下一张图中的完整糖苷作了比较。

entries.en: The older report described aglutition as an inability to swallow rather than a loss of appetite.
entries.zh: 那份较早的报告将吞咽不能描述为无法吞咽，而非食欲丧失。

entries.en: The old case report described aglycaemia but gave no blood sugar measurements.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告描述了血糖缺乏，却未提供血糖测量数值。

entries.en: Her review compared two historical accounts of aglycemia and their descriptions of blood sugar.
entries.zh: 她的综述比较了两份关于血糖缺乏的历史记述及其对血糖的描述。

entries.en: The illustration coloured the aglycone blue and the attached sugar portion yellow.
entries.zh: 该插图将苷元涂成蓝色，将与之相连的糖部分涂成黄色。

entries.en: The historical laboratory record noted aglycosuria because no sugar was detected in the urine sample.
entries.zh: 那份历史化验记录记载了无糖尿，因为在尿液样本中未检出糖。

entries.en: The old study compared aglycosuric subjects with subjects whose urine contained detectable sugar.
entries.zh: 那项旧研究比较了无糖尿的受试者与尿中能检出糖的受试者。

entries.en: The analyst checked the agmatine result against a reference sample before finalising the table.
entries.zh: 分析员在完成表格前，用参比样品核对了胍丁胺的检测结果。

entries.en: The historical course in agmatology compared drawings of several different fracture patterns.
entries.zh: 那门历史上的骨折学课程比较了几种不同骨折形态的图示。

entries.en: The illustration showed agminated nodules beside a second region with widely scattered nodules.
entries.zh: 该插图在一片结节散布很广的区域旁，展示了聚集在一起的结节。

entries.en: The anatomy lecture distinguished agnathia from the presence of a small but developed lower jaw.
entries.zh: 解剖学讲座区分了无下颌畸形与下颌较小但已发育形成的情况。

entries.meaningZh: 无下颌畸胎〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The older anatomical catalogue placed an agnathus illustration beside a drawing of normal jaw development.
entries.zh: 那本较早的解剖学图录将无下颌畸胎插图放在正常颌部发育图旁。

entries.en: The historical account discussed agnea as a recognition difficulty rather than a failure of eyesight.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述将失认作为辨认困难加以讨论，而非将其视为视力失灵。

entries.en: The researcher compared two Agnean passages before writing a note on their differences.
entries.zh: 研究人员在撰写差异说明前，比较了两段阿格尼恩语文字。

entries.meaningZh: 失认；认识不能〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical report described agnoea in a patient who could no longer recognise familiar objects.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告描述了一名已无法认出熟悉物品的患者的失认表现。

entries.en: The report described the condition as agnogenic because its cause had not been established.
entries.zh: 该报告将这种状况描述为原因不明的，因为其病因尚未确定。

entries.en: The analyst repeated the agnosterol measurement after spotting an error in the sample number.
entries.zh: 分析员发现样品编号有误后，重新测定了羊毛甾三烯醇。

entries.en: The old dental report described agomphiasis while noting that the affected teeth remained present.
entries.zh: 那份旧牙科报告描述了牙齿松动，并注明受影响的牙齿仍然存在。

entries.en: The historical illustration showed an agomphious jaw beside one with a complete set of teeth.
entries.zh: 那张历史插图将无牙的颌与牙齿完整的颌并列展示。

entries.en: The historical case discussion distinguished agomphosis from the complete absence of teeth.
entries.zh: 那次历史病例讨论区分了牙齿松动与牙齿完全缺失的情况。

entries.en: The historical chemistry chapter compared agoniadin with other glycosides listed in its table.
entries.zh: 那个历史化学章节将鸡蛋花苷与表中所列的其他糖苷作了比较。

entries.en: The visitor watched an agouty disappear into the vegetation beside the path.
entries.zh: 那位游客看着一只刺豚鼠钻进了小路旁的植被中。

entries.en: The conservator photographed the agraffe before carefully examining the fabric around it.
entries.zh: 修复人员先给搭扣拍了照，然后仔细检查了周围的织物。

entries.en: The historical assessment described agrammaphasia despite the speaker's ability to produce individual words.
entries.zh: 那份历史评估描述了说话者虽能说出单个词，却存在语法缺失的情况。

entries.en: The language assessment discussed agrammatism separately from difficulty recalling individual words.
entries.zh: 那份语言评估将语法缺失与回忆单个词语的困难分开讨论。

entries.en: The old language assessment separated agrammatologia from difficulty articulating individual sounds.
entries.zh: 那份旧语言评估将语法缺失与单个语音的发音困难分开处理。

entries.en: The seminar on agranulemia focused on how earlier reports documented missing granulocytes.
entries.zh: 那场关于粒细胞缺乏症的研讨会重点讨论了早期报告如何记录粒细胞缺乏。

entries.en: The student identified an agranulocyte in the drawing and compared it with the labelled granulocyte.
entries.zh: 学生在图中辨认出一个无颗粒白细胞，并将其与标出的粒细胞作了比较。

entries.en: The case discussion treated agranulocytopenia as a blood-cell finding, not a symptom reported by the patient.
entries.zh: 病例讨论将粒细胞缺乏症视为血细胞检查的发现，而非患者自述的症状。

entries.en: The pathologist questioned the old report's description of the marrow as agranuloplastic.
entries.zh: 病理学家对那份旧报告将骨髓描述为不形成粒细胞的说法提出了质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 痛风血症〔旧医学理论用语〕
entries.en: The historian traced the physician's belief in agremia through several handwritten case notes.
entries.zh: 历史研究者通过几份手写病例记录，追溯了那位医生对痛风血症这一旧说的信奉。

entries.en: The librarian checked AGRIS for records relevant to the student's agricultural research question.
entries.zh: 图书馆员在AGRIS农业信息系统中查找与该学生的农业研究问题有关的记录。
